independent_crosscheck: Every reconstructed polynomial is evaluated at the fixed positive integer witness and compared exactly with aggregate_template from reconstruct_126.py.
interpretation: Each coefficient_orbits entry gives the common ordinary monomial coefficient for every distinct permutation of its exponent partition; omitted exponent partitions have coefficient zero.
method: Exact integer sparse polynomials; inclusion-exclusion enforces union U; determinant multilinearity separates subset sums; labelled monomials are collapsed into permutation orbits only after each determinant, then divided by the exact orbit size.
scope: All ordinary monomial coefficients of every one of the 126 reconstructed Psi_m(L), m<=6.
